text: Python processes only: a non-Python child (git, sh) reads files nobody sees (children.other)

a child Python process is seen only when it inherits PYTHONPATH and runs without -I, -E, -S: a test that builds its own environment starts a child that is not hooked (children.python_unhooked), and so does a child of one
not seen: reads with no event and no wrapped call (C libraries, os.access, os.readlink, os.fwalk, dir_fd, DirEntry.stat, the import system's private stat), symlinks inside the tree

listed_by names the innermost file of the tree on the stack of each listing (listed_via: up to four): what that file's function does with the listing is not recorded, and a listing with no file of the tree on its stack is '<native>'; a directory listed by a child that is not hooked is not in `listed`
the unmutated tree: a mutant may read what the original does not
the interpreter's own walk to find code is left out (--control own-walk records it)
